title: Identical TrainStatusResponse construction duplicated between train_status and cancel_training
description: train_status (lines 109-123) and cancel_training (lines 130-143) build a TrainStatusResponse from the job dict using the exact same 13 fields with the exact same `.get(...)` defaults (status=require_job_status(job), progress, message, iteration, total_iterations, train_loss, train_loss_history, train_loss_history_truncated, elapsed_seconds, result, warning, terminal_reason, execution_metrics). TrainStatusResponse is constructed in only these two places in the entire src tree (grep confirms). Extracting a single private helper, e.g. `_train_status_response(job: Mapping[str, Any]) -> TrainStatusResponse`, would remove ~14 lines of verbatim duplication and ensure both endpoints stay in sync if the response shape ever changes (today a new field must be added in two places).
evidence: Both blocks are character-for-character identical except the surrounding function. grep for `TrainStatusResponse(` returns exactly modelling.py:109 and modelling.py:130.
behavior_preservation: Pure refactor: extract the shared TrainStatusResponse(...) builder into one helper called from both handlers. Output bytes are identical for any given job dict.
